notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 95–395, § 2, Sept. 30, 1978, 92 Stat. 813, which set out congressional findings and declaration of policy, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
Short TitlePub. L. 95–395, § 1, Sept. 30, 1978, 92 Stat. 813, provided that Pub. L. 95–395, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Rhode Island Indian Claims Settlement Act”.
